== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Tonnika Sisters]]. One column per published text state in date order (printed card, Decipher's errata, each Players Committee errata image); the stamp row describes the mark on each image. Revised, Japanese, foil and Virtual printings stay in Versions. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reprints: [[Tonnika Sisters (Reflections Foil)]] has its own column (12 January 2000).
